what: When the footer’s big wordmark reaches 85% of the screen height, each letter starts .05x flat at the bottom and then pops up in one beat (16th-note .106s spacing) — like sound bars filling. With split: none the letters are not split and the color block rises as a whole from .16x in 1.05s (kelvin)

options.bpm: Beat tempo — all lengths in beat units, default 142 (one beat .4225s)
options.each: Delay between letters (s), default a quarter beat
options.ease: Curve, default 0.16,1,0.3,1 — a GSAP name (expo.out) also works
options.split: If ”none”, the text isn’t split and the whole element rises
options.origin: If ”top”, grows from the top edge downward, default is bottom
options.order: If “random,” characters rise in shuffled order, default is from the front
